title: Backpack Hero
description: Arrange and merge swords, bows, and daggers inside your grid backpack between waves, then unleash auto-battles across 15 escalating monster raids.
controls: Drag weapons and extra bag slots into your backpack, merge matching weapons to level up, tap Refresh for new gear, and hit Battle to fight.

zh-CN.title: 背包英雄
zh-CN.description: 爆款格子背包合成肉鸽：每波战前自由摆放并合成升级剑、弓、匕首与扩容格，迎战 15 波怪物大军。
zh-CN.controls: 拖拽武器与背包格放入背包，拖到同级武器上合成进阶；点刷新换装备，点开战迎击波次敌人。
